exams.name: LPI BSD Specialist
exams.blurb: LPI certification covering FreeBSD, NetBSD and OpenBSD administration including installation, packages, storage, networking and system services.

exams.name: LPI DevOps Tools Engineer
exams.blurb: Vendor-neutral LPI certification covering container and configuration management tools, CI/CD, infrastructure as code and service operations.

exams.name: LPI Linux Essentials
exams.blurb: Entry-level LPI certificate covering Linux history and licensing, the command line, files and directories, scripting basics and security concepts.

exams.name: LPI Open Source Essentials
exams.blurb: LPI certificate covering open source licensing, governance, community collaboration, compliance and building an open source strategy.

exams.name: LPI Security Essentials
exams.blurb: Entry-level LPI certificate covering security concepts, device and network security, encryption, privacy and safe use of everyday computing services.

exams.name: LPI Web Development Essentials
exams.blurb: Entry-level LPI certificate covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, NodeJS and SQL fundamentals for people starting in web software development.

exams.name: LPIC-1: Linux Administrator
exams.blurb: Two-exam LPI certification covering Linux installation, package management, shell scripting, file systems, networking and basic system security.

exams.name: LPIC-2: Linux Engineer
exams.blurb: Two-exam LPI certification on advanced administration including kernel tuning, storage, network services, email, web servers and system maintenance.

exams.name: LPIC-3: High Availability and Storage Clusters
exams.blurb: Senior LPI specialisation covering cluster management, load balancing, distributed storage and high-availability Linux service configuration.

exams.name: LPIC-3: Mixed Environments
exams.blurb: Senior LPI specialisation covering Samba, OpenLDAP and integrating Linux servers into Windows and mixed enterprise directory environments.

exams.name: LPIC-3: Security
exams.blurb: Senior LPI specialisation covering cryptography, access control, application security, network security and intrusion detection on Linux systems.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Architect
exams.blurb: Top Red Hat credential earned by passing five additional specialist exams after RHCE, across infrastructure, cloud, containers or automation tracks.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Engineer
exams.blurb: Performance-based Red Hat exam focused on automating RHEL administration with Ansible playbooks, roles and system roles; requires a current RHCSA.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Advanced Automation
exams.blurb: Red Hat exam on advanced Ansible Automation Platform skills including complex playbooks, custom filters, collections and automation controller workflows.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Containers
exams.blurb: Hands-on Red Hat exam on building, running and managing containers with Podman, including images, registries, volumes and multi-container applications.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
exams.blurb: Hands-on Red Hat exam on installing, configuring and managing OpenShift clusters including authentication, networking, storage and application workloads.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Application Development
exams.blurb: Performance-based Red Hat exam on deploying and managing containerised applications on OpenShift, including builds, pipelines and configuration.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Security: Linux
exams.blurb: Red Hat exam on hardening RHEL systems using SELinux, auditing, OpenSCAP compliance scanning, encryption and centralised identity management.

exams.name: Red Hat Certified System Administrator
exams.blurb: Hands-on Red Hat exam on core Linux administration including users, storage, networking, SELinux, containers and system troubleshooting on RHEL.

exams.name: Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Follow-on Google programme covering Python, statistics, regression modelling and machine learning for candidates moving beyond entry-level analytics.

exams.name: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level online programme covering security frameworks, network security, Linux, SQL, Python and incident detection for aspiring SOC analysts.

exams.name: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level online programme covering the data analysis process with spreadsheets, SQL, R and Tableau, ending in a portfolio case study.

exams.name: Google IT Support Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level online programme covering troubleshooting, networking, operating systems, system administration and security for help desk roles.

exams.name: Google UX Design Professional Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level online programme covering user research, wireframing, prototyping in Figma and building a user experience design portfolio.

exams.name: CloudBees Certified Jenkins Engineer
exams.blurb: Vendor certification on Jenkins administration and pipeline development, covering jobs, agents, plugins, security and continuous integration practice.

exams.name: Docker Certified Associate
exams.blurb: Container fundamentals credential covering image management, orchestration, storage, networking and security; the programme is no longer actively sold.

exams.name: Puppet Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Configuration-management certification covering Puppet manifests, modules, Hiera data, node classification and Puppet Enterprise administration.

exams.name: BSD Associate
exams.blurb: Long-standing entry-level BSD certification covering installation, user management, networking and maintenance across the major BSD operating systems.

exams.name: Oracle Linux System Administrator Certified Professional
exams.blurb: Oracle certification covering Oracle Linux installation, package management with DNF, storage, systemd services, networking and kernel management.
